001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
005
006/**
007 * The shop trading type *SELLING* or *BUYING*
008 */
009public enum ShopType {
010  SELLING(0), // Sell Mode
011  BUYING(1), // Buy Mode
012  FROZEN(2); //Locked so no mode
013  private final int id;
014
015  ShopType(final int id) {
016
017    this.id = id;
018  }
019
020  public static @Nullable ShopType fromString(@NotNull final String string) {
021
022    for(final ShopType type : ShopType.values()) {
023      if(type.name().equalsIgnoreCase(string)) {
024        return type;
025      }
026    }
027    return null;
028  }
029
030
031  public static @NotNull ShopType fromID(final int id) {
032
033    for(final ShopType type : ShopType.values()) {
034      if(type.id == id) {
035        return type;
036      }
037    }
038    return SELLING;
039  }
040
041  public static int toID(@NotNull final ShopType shopType) {
042
043    return shopType.id;
044  }
045
046  public int toID() {
047
048    return id;
049  }
050}
